# Guard a failed C string search before pointer arithmetic

The original-message URI loop can fail to find another :// and leave nextUri null. The accepted change places uri = nextUri + 1 inside if (nextUri). A later loop condition would not make null pointer arithmetic valid because the arithmetic has already occurred. Manual C++ proposal for this parsing path: guard the search result before using or incrementing its pointer and explain the exceptional input when it is not obvious. Entries 615 and 617 contain the same guard; 616 is its inverse backout. The source and commit messages do not establish the exact build-failure cause or why the identical reland succeeded. No sanitizer or parsing test was run.

Scope: compose.
